svg.text: Side view, looking along +y (true scale, z up)
Loop profiles (drawn at reference span)
STD20: Au 20 µm, ball-wedge
forward, first bond on the die; moves 180/0 30/12% -20/35%
control points at 710 µm span, spline between them
PWR20: Au 20 µm, ball-wedge
forward, first bond on the die; moves 220/0 30/12% -30/40%
control points at 690 µm span, spline between them
STEP20: Au 20 µm, ball-wedge
forward, first bond on the die; moves 120/0 30/12% -20/35%
control points at 870 µm span, spline between them
STK23: Au 23 µm, ball-wedge
forward, first bond on the die; moves 200/0 20/10% -40/60%
control points at 1690 µm span, spline between them
Stack
D2 die, 200 µm assumed, z 330 to 530
D2 attach, 25 µm assumed, z 305 to 330
D1 die, 280 µm assumed, z 25 to 305
D1 attach, 25 µm assumed, z 0 to 25
Substrate, 800 µm, z -800 to 0
Key
STD20: 44 wires
PWR20: 18 wires
STEP20: 12 wires
STK23: 12 wires
86 wires on 2 die. Hover any wire, pad, land or layer for details.
Board fiducials on the substrate copper: J1.F1 align, J1.F2 align.
Rules: wire gap 60 µm, die edge clearance 40 µm.
Die thickness and attach are assumed. Written by Wire Bond Bench.
Board, top view (1 : 5)
